## Security and dependencies
- Updated Rust dependencies to resolve 21 of the 23 advisories reported by `cargo audit` on the previous dependency lockfile.
- Updated rustls, QUIC dependencies, Tokio and certificate stores.
- Updated plist/quick-xml and zip. The updater plugin is now 2.14.1, including safer installation and signature verification fixes.

## Builds
- Updated GitHub Actions to Node 24 runtimes. Build scripts now use Node 22 instead of the end-of-life Node 20.
- Before publication, verify the actual updater files and their signatures, require all four desktop targets, and pin download URLs to the release tag.

## Website
- Rebuilt the product website as a single page with features, RLM limitations, release changes and platform downloads.

## Known limits
- Two Rust advisories remain: libsqlite3-sys (RUSTSEC-2026-0459) and rsa via sqlx-mysql (RUSTSEC-2023-0071). Updating these requires a coordinated database dependency migration; they have not been suppressed.
- RLM chat is available on macOS and Linux, not on Windows.
- Long RLM tasks and Goal mode still need manual verification with a live model. Automated checks do not replace that test.
